verdict.rationale: Godot exposes a documented, object-oriented public API usable from GDScript, C#, C++ or GDExtension. EditorInterface and EditorScript let scripts control the editor (save/load scenes, edit resources, run tools), and the documented headless CLI enables scripted automation, so the product can be driven programmatically through its documented API. A keyless Asset Library JSON API and a built-in GDScript LSP add further machine-accessible surfaces. Missing for 10: no external/remote control API (HTTP/OpenAPI) for out-of-process agents, no official MCP server (only fragmented community ones), no llms.txt or markdown docs for agent consumption, and no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven editor automation.
